content.stem: 一家银行的客户顾问联系合规团队的一名成员,寻求指导如何处理一位客户希望将出售加密资产所得的25万美元转入其在该银行的储蓄账户一事.合规团队应当提供哪些指导？

options.A: 建议进一步澄清相关情况，包括出售的是哪些加密货币或代币，以及该加密货币交易所是否对其客户进行尽职调查
options.B: 建议停止该交易，因为加密资产总体上不受监管，其性质决定了会给银行带来不可接受的反洗钱风险
options.C: 向顾问确认，如果客户的KYC（了解您的客户）信息是最新的，并且在公共区块链浏览器上进行搜索未发现任何负面媒体报道，客户可以继续进行交易
options.D: 向顾问确认客户可以进行交易，因为客户已正确完成KYC（了解您的客户）流程

content.stem_en: A client advisor at a bank contacts a member of the compliance team for guidance on how to proceed with a client who wants to transfer US$250,000 from the sale of cryptoassets into their savings account at the bank. What guidance should the compliance team provide?

options_en.A: Advise that further clarification is necessary, including which coins or tokens were sold and whether the crypto exchange conducts due diligence on its clients
options_en.B: Advise that the transaction should be stopped because cryptoassets in general are not regulated and by definition pose an unacceptable AML risk for the bank
options_en.C: Confirm to the advisor that the customer can proceed with the transaction if the customer's KYC information is up to date and a search on a public blockchain explorer does not identify any adverse media
options_en.D: Confirm to the advisor that the customer can proceed with the transaction because the customer has properly completed the KYC process
